name: Northwind Office Supply
text: Northwind Office Supply (V-1001) ships office paper, toner and desk accessories from Austin, Texas. Bills monthly in USD against a purchase order; Texas sales tax applies.

name: Bluepeak Logistics
text: Bluepeak Logistics (V-1002) is the LTL freight carrier for Dallas and Denver lanes. Freight is billed in USD, tax exempt, and must reference a purchase order; credit notes reference the original invoice instead.

name: Harbor & Pine Consulting
text: Harbor & Pine Consulting (V-1003), legal name Harbor and Pine Consulting LLC, provides advisory hours and workshop facilitation. Bills in USD under a statement of work PO; Washington services tax at 7.25%.

name: Tallow Print Co.
text: Tallow Print Co. (V-1004) prints business cards, brochures, banners and signage. Bills in USD per purchase order; 6% sales tax on printed goods.

name: Kestrel Industrial GmbH
text: Kestrel Industrial GmbH (V-2001) supplies hydraulic fittings and pressure gauges from Germany. Invoices in EUR with German VAT at 19%.

name: Granite Cloud Services Ltd
text: Granite Cloud Services Ltd (V-2002) provides managed Kubernetes and object storage. Invoices monthly in GBP with UK VAT at 20%.
